cim: Huntington University Receives $5 Million Grant from Lilly Endowment Inc. for Artificial Intelligence (AI) Programs
cim_eredeti: Huntington University Receives $5 Million Grant from Lilly Endowment Inc. for Artificial Intelligence (AI) Programs
szoveg_eredeti:
HUNTINGTON, Ind. — Huntington University has received a grant of $5 million from Lilly Endowment Inc. to help implement a comprehensive, campus-wide strategy for integrating artificial intelligence across teaching, student workforce preparation and institutional operations in alignment with its Christ-centered mission.

Over the next three years, Huntington University will focus on three priorities. It will equip faculty and staff to lead well as AI changes higher education. It will prepare students with the access, skills and credentials employers increasingly expect. Finally, it will update the technology and operations that support this work across campus. The effort grows out of months of planning with faculty, staff, students and regional partners, and it reflects the University's commitment to forming graduates who use AI with wisdom, integrity and purpose to impact the world for Christ.

“Artificial intelligence is reshaping how our students will interact with the world,” said Dr. Robert Pepper, president of Huntington University. “This support from Lilly Endowment allows us to approach that change intentionally, with our Christian mission at the center, so our graduates are prepared not only to use these tools well, but to use them wisely.”

The project is being funded through Lilly Endowment’s initiative, Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education. This initiative isdesigned to support colleges and universities in Indiana as they develop and implement approaches for using artificial intelligence. The grants will help ensure that their students, faculty and staff are well-equipped to learn, work and live in a world increasingly influenced by AI. Huntington University is one of 35 colleges and universities in Indiana receiving funding through the initiative.

About Lilly Endowment Inc. Lilly Endowment Inc. is an Indianapolis-based, private foundation created in 1937 by J.K. Lilly and his sons, Eli and J.K. Jr., through gifts of stock in their pharmaceutical business, Eli Lilly and Company. While those gifts remain the financial bedrock of the Endowment, the Endowment is a separate entity from the company, with a distinct governing board, staff and location. Although the Endowment maintains a special commitment to its founders’ hometown, Indianapolis, and home state, Indiana, it also funds programs throughout the United States, especially in the field of religion.

About Huntington University: Huntington University is a comprehensive Christian college of the liberal arts offering award-winning graduate, undergraduate and online programs in more than 70 academic concentrations. Founded in Huntington, Indiana, in 1897 by the Church of the United Brethren in Christ, Huntington University has over a century of experience educating graduates who are ready to impact the world for Christ through scholarship and service. The quality of education is high as reflected in Huntington’s top quartile ranking in the 2026 U.S. News Best Regional Universities Midwest Rankings. The nonprofit university’s locations include the original home campus in Huntington, a doctoral program in occupational therapy and an accelerated baccalaureate nursing program in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and an undergraduate and doctoral program location in Peoria, Arizona. Huntington University’s home campus offers 18 official men’s and women’s athletic programs, and the university is a member of the Council for Christian Colleges and Universities (CCCU).
